judge_reading.resolving_power_descriptive: POST HOC, descriptive: paired L0 - L4 (identity vs matched-scale Gaussian) mean -0.24, bootstrap 95% [-1.31, 0.87] held_auc on a level of 156.7 (<= ~0.8%); L0 - L2 +0.19 [-0.85, 1.23]. FLAT is therefore a bounded null: any donor-STRUCTURE effect on held_auc is smaller than ~1.3 at this budget, not 'no information'.
judge_reading.observation_that_survives: Every donor-derived arm beats scratch (E's own vs_scratch, p <= 8e-4 each), INCLUDING L4 which keeps only each donor genome's W mean/sd: L4 - scratch +2.10 [1.19, 2.98] vs L0 - scratch +1.86 [0.84, 2.90]. The graft-over-scratch advantage survives destruction of all structure down to gross scale. INTERPRETATION (not a verdict, not 'transfer'): consistent with SWARM_R8 s7 outcome (B)-family reading -- the machinery responds to initialisation scale, not donor structure; a scale-matched non-donor Gaussian arm would be the cheaper discriminator.
